collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A work crew has been rushing to finish a roof before the rains, and the crew leader sees everyone is exhausted.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A work crew has been rushing to finish a roof before the rains, and (name1), the crew leader, notices everyone is exhausted and making small mistakes.

choices.label: Stop for a Full Day of Rest.
Ask the Crew What They Need.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The crew returns refreshed and finishes faster than expected.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The rain arrives early, and the crew covers the open roof with mats in time.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Half the crew rests while the other half works, and the roof keeps growing.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The shifts confuse everyone, and they return to working together.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They ask for shorter days and more water, which the leader arranges.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Everyone says they are fine, but the leader calls a break anyway.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Few people are free, but the help that comes is welcome.

d1__fx.name: Outcome D1
d1__fx.text: Fresh hands make the work lighter, and the crew can rest.

d1__text.text: Fresh hands make the work lighter, and the crew can rest.
